headline: SITCON eases to 3 (ELEVATED); Zyxel GS1900 patch still bypassed; WordPress KEV deadline is today; cPGuard supply-chain attack

bullets.text: Changed: SITCON dropped from 2 (SEVERE) to 3 (ELEVATED). Drivers: 1 KEV addition in 72 hours and 3 critical reports in 48 hours. The last 7 days scored 0.68x the 90-day average. Active campaigns remain; check exposure this week.

Still active, Zyxel GS1900, 4 outlets: Zyxel's fix for a zero-day used to hack nearly 1,000 switches did not block the in-the-wild exploit (CVE-2026-107441), which allows root command execution. Top story on the board.

Due today, WordPress Core: CISA KEV lists CVE-2026-119977, a TOCTOU race condition exploited for RCE, federal due date 2026-11-06. Apple CVE-2024-27834, exploited to deliver info-stealers, is due 2026-11-18.

Still active, supply chain: cPGuard autoupdate was hijacked in the OpsShield attack to serve malicious updates (4 outlets). The NIKKE PC game launcher was also hacked to spread remote-access and data-stealing malware.

AI-enabled fraud and secret theft: three people were charged over a $129 million scheme using AI to impersonate CEOs and attorneys; Microsoft reports threat actors using agentic AI tooling to find and abuse exposed secrets.

Also on the board: OpenSSH emergency fix for long-password auth bypass on Alpine Linux; Barracuda critical root-access flaws; mSecure and DreamHost breaches; FBI/CISA warn of attacks on refrigeration and cooling systems.

actions: Patch WordPress Core for CVE-2026-119977 today (KEV due 2026-11-06).
Treat Zyxel GS1900 switches as exposed even after patching: restrict management access, check for compromise, watch for a new fix.
cPGuard users: check servers for malicious updates and rotate credentials; NIKKE launcher users should scan for malware.
Apply the OpenSSH emergency fix on Alpine Linux hosts and Barracuda's fixes for the critical root-access flaws.
Scan repos, CI logs and public buckets for exposed secrets and rotate any found.
Require out-of-band verification for payment or wire requests that appear to come from executives or lawyers.
